report.summary:
PR #189 (https://github.com/gera3d/superagent-sandbox/pull/189) is ready for review: one ticket-linked artifact PR on `agent/finding-evidence-card-71dc25902cce` with `patches/NATIVE_FINDING_EVIDENCE_UI.patch` (applies cleanly to a pristine worktree at exact base 9992dec) and `reports/NATIVE_FINDING_EVIDENCE_UI.md`.

Implementation (`src/client/finding-card.tsx`, client-only; no server/schema/prompt changes): native "Record operator-reviewed evidence" form shown only for the same dispatched `running`/`blocked` finding with a current job. Fields: durable reference, verification results/limits, next decision, explicit "I personally ran or inspected these results" verified attestation. One explicit click POSTs `{revision, reference, evidence, nextDecision, verified}` to the existing protected `POST /findings/:id/evidence` with the same management headers as review/confirm; nothing is forged or bypassed and localApproval still comes from the browser same-origin envelope. Recording is observation only: no review/confirm/queue/merge/deploy/scope call. A 409 surfaces the server message plus refresh guidance, preserves the draft, disables submit until the authoritative revision advances and never auto-retries. Success says it did not accept the finding or delivery. The separate current-revision accept-evidence flow and exact full-requirements acknowledgment are untouched; only latest explicitly verified current-job evidence is selectable, matching the existing server rule; prior reports/history remain append-only and rendered.

Verification actually run in the isolated clone (node_modules + sibling dsh-next-steps symlinked, no downloads): `tests/finding-card.spec.tsx` 25/25 passed (new tests: no record before explicit click, exact finding/revision payload, draft-preserving stale-409 recovery with exactly one request, observation vs acceptance separation, no form without a dispatched job/current state, protected payload carries no authority field); `tests/finding.spec.ts` + `tests/finding-consumers.spec.tsx` 28/28 passed; targeted `tests/runtime.spec.ts -t "runs registered finding intake"` passed, preserving the existing evidence 403-without-local-approval, stale-409 and 200 flow; `tsc --noEmit` exit 0. Full `tests/runtime.spec.ts`: 99 passed, 1 unrelated pre-existing failure at line 1082 asserting installed prompt text, identical at the base and untouched by this patch.

Limitation: no before/after native screenshots, consistent with the ticket reserving installed native visual verification for root and PR #185 precedent; this is a reviewable patch artifact, not a live-verified UI, and no live acceptance is claimed. PR has no CI checks, no reviews and no bot rounds (0), no reviewers credited. No merge CLI is named in the delivery requirements, so a person merges PR #189; no auto-merge enabled.

report.summary:
Ready for human review: PR #186 https://github.com/gera3d/superagent-sandbox/pull/186 (head agent/finding-concurrency-d65f3131a9ae, base main, author gera3d; files: patches/CONCURRENT_FINDING_DISPATCH.patch, reports/CONCURRENT_FINDING_DISPATCH.md; no CI checks configured; not merged/deployed/accepted).

What changed (5 files, 191+/25-): FindingStore now counts dispatched jobs and nextQueued(capacity=1) admits only the lowest-seq queued finding while runningCount < capacity; markDispatched revalidates the same capacity inside its transaction and stays idempotent. FindingRuntime.dispatch() loops up to executor.maxWorkers minus slots held by genuinely busy ordinary tickets (new workerBusy dependency wired to executor.running), binding each job in the same Store.atomic as Engine.dispatchFinding and the delivery audit. The global "all finding tickets quiescent" gate became a per-finding priorWorkQuiescent gate, so reviewing/recovering one finding no longer serializes independent findings. Capacity is re-read inside each dispatch transaction; pause stops admission; reducing capacity never touches in-flight work. Default capacity 1 preserves the old serial behavior. Authority, bounded scope, repository match, native GitHub association and human review/acceptance are unchanged; native WorkerSlots still cap actual launches.

Verification (actual): baseline worktree at 9992dec with only the new test file failed the capacity-three test with 1 running + 2 queued; patched tree: tests/finding.spec.ts 26/26 and tests/finding-runtime.spec.ts 19/19 (45/45), `tsc --noEmit` exit 0, `tsdown` build exit 0. Published patch hash matches the locally verified patch and `git apply --check` against pristine 9992dec succeeds. New tests cover three at capacity three, next-waiting, FIFO/idempotency under repeated wakes, pause + capacity reduction, cross-finding isolation from a blocked peer, and ordinary-ticket slot accounting. No bot review rounds occurred. Code directory: /Users/gerayeremin/Library/Application Support/dsh-desktop/harness/state/superagent/work/finding-concurrency-d65f3131a9ae/code. A person must merge; no auto-merge was enabled.
